the FexCo1-xP cocatalysts can greatly improve the performance of CdS for photocatlytic hydrogen production.
the substitution of some Co ions by Fe ions in CoP cocatalyst can greatly improve the electrochemical and photocatalytic performance.
the ternary Fex Co1 xP cocatlyst, which is synthesized by an in situ chemical deposition method, can be used as an efficient cocatalyst for photocatalytic H2 production.

the preparation of highly active FexCoP cocatalysts for photocatalytic water reduction and the investigation of the relationship between the structure of FexCoP and its photocatalytic activity.
the design of a highly efficient FexCo1 -xP cocatalyst to improve the hydrogen generation rate and quantum efficiency of CdS for hydrogen production under the visible light irradiation.
the synthesis and photocatalytic performance evaluation of ternary F ex Co 1 - x P cocatalysts modified on CdS.

this work provides a new strategy for the design of noble-metal-free co catalyst for photocatalytic H2 production, which can be applied in other semiconductor photocatalysts.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have successfully synthesized a highly efficient FexCo1xP co catalyst and the photocatalyst of FexCo0.6/CdS has been found to be an effective and stable photocatalyst for solar hydrogen production.
a new noble metal free ternary Fex Co1 xP co-catalyst was successfully prepared and the photocatalytical activity of CdS was greatly improved after the modification of FexCo 1 xP.
we have successfully prepared a highly active FexCo 1 xP cocata lyst, which can greatly promote the photocatalytic efficiency of CdS for hydrogen production.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the substitution of a small amount of Fe into CoP cocatalyst can greatly improve the hydrogen production performance of the CdS photocatalysts.
the substitution of some Fe for Co in the CoP can change its electrochemical activity and the photocatalysis of FexCo 1 xP/Cds is also dependent on the molarity x of Fe.
the substitution of some Fe ions for Co ions in Co-P can change the electrocatalytic property of FexCoP and the photocorrosion of CdS.
